response.sql: SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_customers_per_employee FROM (SELECT e.EmployeeId, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS cnt FROM Employee e LEFT JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId) t

assumptions.assumption: All rows in Employee count as employees (not just those with a support-rep title), so employees with no customers contribute zero to the average. Customers with NULL SupportRepId are excluded from the counts.
